description: Test script for verifying persistence of todo items after page reload in a TodoMVC application, including adding, completing, reloading, and verifying items using Playwright assertions and actions.

methods.name: expectValue
methods.description: Asserts that a checkbox or input has a specific value, e.g., checked or text.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills a textbox with specified text and optionally submits it.

methods.name: expectAria
methods.description: Validates the ARIA structure of the page matches the expected list of todos.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Simulates a click action on a specified element.

methods.name: pressKey
methods.description: Simulates pressing a specific key (e.g., F5 for reload).

methods.name: expectVisible
methods.description: Verifies that a specific element, such as text or a role, is visible on the page.

calls: page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'What needs to be done?' })
